description: Which PACs give the most: contributors to tracked candidates ranked by total dollars (FEC Schedule A), by election cycle, with donor-processing conduits like ActBlue and WinRed separated out. mode=disbursers ranks committees by their own reported disbursements instead. Use for "which PACs donate the most to Congress" questions; for super PACs use super_pacs.

cycle.description: Two-year election cycle, e.g. 2026 or 2024; omit for all
